scope: Pure bounded JSON validation and derived frozen model pins only. No actual receipt provenance, freshness, host wiring or authorization.
behavior: Strict bounded JSON rejects duplicate decoded keys, prototype keys, nonfinite values, unknown fields and malformed schemas.
Receipt and certificate canonical digests must match independently trusted context; normalized role bindings, source/context/evidence identities and API process identity must agree.
OLD and NEW keep one API mapping; worker configured and resolved paths differ. Shared components cannot contain conflicting identity metadata.
Success derives detached recursively frozen pins; refusal contains no partial pins or raw input fragments.
limitations: Controlling both inputs permits fabricated agreement. This validator does not authenticate the caller or evidence origin.
Actual OLD/NEW certificates, independently reviewed receipt/context, NEW filesystem identity, API identity and freshness remain operational RD6 gates.
Directory size and times are informational; symlink metadata remains invariant.
No real receipts, private selectors, host, PostgreSQL, payload reconstruction, RD7 measurement, deployment or production wiring was tested.
